scenario: Invalid component name after `.utc` per LTIM.6.3: `m.fired_at.utc.nanosecond` names no component of `Time`, and components are members of the receiver ([LGRA.9.6.2]), so it is refused with DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER. `.utc` itself is a valid member, so only the component is wrong.
rules_ds:
schema Event scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    fired_at: Time mutable

rule r:
    Event m where m.fired_at.utc.nanosecond > 0
->
    log info "x"
